publicationStmt.p: Tag layer of the DHSS Meta-Tagging Project. The article text is reproduced from the staged copy named in sourceDesc and is not altered; the tags are held separately in standOff so that overlapping and nested spans are preserved.

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: metagenomic features - organisms, clades, OTUs, genes or pathways - that differ between two or more microbial communities
span.quote: LEfSe determines the features (organisms, clades, operational taxonomic units, genes, or functions) most likely to explain differences between classes by coupling standard tests for statistical significance with additional tests encoding biological consistency and effect relevance.

span.label: how to find biomarkers that EXPLAIN a difference between conditions rather than merely differ across them
span.quote: Specifically, LEfSe determines features potentially able to explain the differences among conditions rather than the features that simply possess uneven distributions among classes.

span.label: LEfSe: significance, biological consistency and effect size coupled into one procedure, which the paper says no existing method provides together
span.quote: However, none of these methods, even those offering nuanced analyses of metagenomic data, provide biological class explanations to establish statistical significance, biological consistency, and effect size estimation of predicted biomarkers.

span.label: method
span.quote: LEfSe determines the features (organisms, clades, operational taxonomic units, genes, or functions) most likely to explain differences between classes by coupling standard tests for statistical significance with additional tests encoding biological consistency and effect relevance.

span.label: differential abundance of microbial features between phenotypes
span.quote: This problem is referred to as class comparison: how can the differences between phenotypes such as tumor subtype or disease state be explained in terms of consistent biological pathways or molecular mechanisms?

span.label: Kruskal-Wallis for significance, pairwise Wilcoxon among subclasses for consistency, linear discriminant analysis for effect size
span.term: Kruskal-Wallis for significance, pairwise Wilcoxon among subclasses for consistency, linear discriminant analysis for effect size
span.quote: Specifically, we first use the non-parametric factorial Kruskal- Wallis (KW) sum-rank test [49] to detect features with significant differential abundance with respect to the class of interest; biological consistency is subsequently investigated using a set of pairwise tests among subclasses using the (unpaired) Wilcoxon rank-sum test [50,51]. As a last step, LEfSe uses LDA [52] to estimate the effect size of each differentially abundant feature

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THREE TESTS IN SEQUENCE, EACH ASKING A DIFFERENT QUESTION: a Kruskal-Wallis rank test for whether the feature differs at all, pairwise Wilcoxon tests among SUBCLASSES for whether the difference is consistent with the population structure, and LDA for how big it is
span.note: about this quote: the quote carries a line-break hyphen scar: the paper's “Kruskal-Wallis” is staged as “Kruskal- Wallis”. Verbatim against the staged text; the damage is mid-name and cannot be re-sliced around. Confidence 0.85 under Q-606.
span.quote: Specifically, we first use the non-parametric factorial Kruskal- Wallis (KW) sum-rank test [49] to detect features with significant differential abundance with respect to the class of interest; biological consistency is subsequently investigated using a set of pairwise tests among subclasses using the (unpaired) Wilcoxon rank-sum test [50,51]. As a last step, LEfSe uses LDA [52] to estimate the effect size of each differentially abundant feature

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: EXPLAINING RATHER THAN DETECTING: the method keeps features able to explain the difference between conditions, not merely those with uneven distributions - which is what a significance test alone returns
span.quote: Specifically, LEfSe determines features potentially able to explain the differences among conditions rather than the features that simply possess uneven distributions among classes.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: PRIOR KNOWLEDGE AS A CONSTRAINT ON A HIGH-DIMENSIONAL SEARCH: the biological hypothesis is encoded and used to narrow the space, which is the paper's answer to having far more candidate biomarkers than samples
span.quote: The introduction of prior biological knowledge in the method contributes to constrain the analysis and thus to address the challenges traditionally connected with high-dimensional data mining.

span.label: THE TRADE IS STATED AND PRICED: a substantially better false positive rate is bought with a moderately increased false negative rate, and the paper says the user can adjust where it sits
span.quote: We further evaluated LEfSe using synthetic data, observing that it achieves a substantially better false positive rate compared to standard statistical tests, at the price of a moderately increased false negative rate (that can be adjusted as needed by the user).

span.label: There are typically far more candidate biomarkers than samples, which is a property of the data and not of the method
span.note: about this quote: the quote carries a spurious space inside a word (taxonomy shape 8): “associated with” is staged as “associated w ith”. Confidence 0.85.
span.quote: Related challenges are associated w ith high-dimensional data regardless of the data type or experimental platform; the number of potential biomarkers, for example, is typically much higher than the number of samples

span.label: Microbial communities show remarkably high inter-subject variability, alongside sequencing errors and chimeric reads
span.quote: Metagenomic analyses additionally present their own specific issues, including sequencing errors, chimeric reads [27,28], and complex underlying biology; many microbial communities have been found to show remarkably high inter-subject variability.

span.label: Finding a biomarker is stated to be only a PRECURSOR to understanding a mechanism - the method does not claim to deliver the biology
span.quote: Moreover, simply identifying potential biomarkers without elucidating their biological consistency and roles is only a precursor to understanding the underlying mechanisms of microbe-microbe or host-microbe interactions

span.label: the approach validated on three independent bodies of data - human microbiomes, a mouse model of ulcerative colitis, and environmental samples
span.note: eliminates: a biomarker method tuned to one dataset's structure - three data sources of different kinds are what shows the discovery is not a property of any one of them
span.quote: We validated this approach using data from human microbiomes, a mouse model of ulcerative colitis, and environmental samples, in each case predicting groups of organisms or operational taxonomic units that concisely differentiate the classes being compared.

Distinguished by the paper from class DISCOVERY (finding subtypes) and class PREDICTION (assigning a new sample) - three tasks, one dataset, and the paper says which one it is doing
span.quote: This problem is referred to as class comparison: how can the differences between phenotypes such as tumor subtype or disease state be explained in terms of consistent biological pathways or molecular mechanisms?

span.label: effect size - USED HERE AS AN ORTHOGONAL AXIS TO THE P-VALUE, not as a refinement of it: a very significant difference can be too small to matter, and a marker at p = 0.01 can carry a large effect whose significance was eaten by technical noise
span.quote: Differences between classes can be very statistically significant (low P-value) but so small that they are unlikely to be biologically responsible for phenotypic differences.

span.label: class comparison —distinct-from→ class prediction
span.quote: Note that as we are performing class comparison rather than class prediction, it is worth specifying that the effect size estimation accuracy of an algorithm is not directly connected with its predictive ability
